designationHistory.name: Nisqually National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved the establishment of Nisqually National Wildlife Refuge; it was renamed for tribal leader Billy Frank Jr. in 2015.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Billy Frank Jr. Nisqually National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS press release, Aug. 2024, "50th Celebration for Billy Frank Jr. Nisqually National Wildlife Refuge": "established in 1974 with approval by the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission"

review.note: Draft sentence described the National Natural Landmarks program (1962). Refuge: 1974, MBCC approval (FWS 50th-anniversary release). Exact date not found.
